intro: Ten stories from the last day, rewritten in plain British English. Tap any word you don't know.

items.title: Europe to join the next Ukraine peace talks
items.text: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Vladimir Putin in Moscow and asked Russia to let European representatives join talks on ending the war in Ukraine. President Zelensky said Europe would take part in the next round, but the Kremlin has not confirmed this. Mr Putin has said he opposes European peacekeepers in Ukraine. The meeting followed the first direct talks between Russia and Ukraine for nine months, which were held in Abu Dhabi. No date has been set for the next round.

gloss.envoy: a person sent to represent their government
gloss.peacekeepers: soldiers who are sent to keep peace after fighting
gloss.round: one stage of a series of talks
gloss.confirm: to say officially that something is true

items.title: Trump takes Vance off Iran talks
items.text: President Trump has removed Vice President JD Vance from the negotiations with Iran. Mr Trump said the United States no longer needs a deal. The move came after Republican losses in last week's midterm elections, which Mr Vance linked to the war. Oil prices rose, with Brent crude up 3.3% to about $96 a barrel. Iranian forces also reported that two oil tankers hit mines near the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday.

gloss.negotiations: formal talks to reach an agreement
gloss.midterm elections: US elections held halfway through a president's term
gloss.link to: to say that two things are connected
gloss.mine: a hidden bomb that explodes when something touches it
gloss.crude oil: oil in its natural form, before it is refined

items.title: Indonesia's vice president resigns
items.text: Indonesia's Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned on Thursday after the highest courts ruled that documents about his education abroad did not meet election rules. President Prabowo Subianto accepted the resignation. Parliament will choose a replacement within 60 days. The rupiah fell to a record low on the day, and about 20,000 soldiers have been deployed in the capital, Jakarta. Mr Gibran is the son of former President Joko Widodo.

gloss.rule: to make an official legal decision
gloss.replacement: a person who takes another person's place
gloss.deploy: to send soldiers or equipment to a place

items.title: Two men guilty of spying on Iranian dissidents
items.text: Two Iranian men have been found guilty at Woolwich Crown Court of helping a foreign intelligence service. Mostafa Sepahvand, 41, and Farhad Javadi Manesh, 46, watched journalists at the London-based channel Iran International, as well as a lawyer. Prosecutors said they worked for Iran's Revolutionary Guards. Sepahvand was also convicted of preparing an attack, but Javadi Manesh was cleared of that charge. Police said the pair used ChatGPT for research. They will be sentenced in December, and Tehran denies such operations.

gloss.dissident: a person who publicly criticises their government
gloss.intelligence service: a government organisation that collects secret information
gloss.convict: to decide in court that someone is guilty
gloss.clear of: to decide that someone is not guilty
gloss.sentence: to announce the punishment for a crime
gloss.deny: to say that something is not true

items.title: England name squad for Croatia and Spain games
items.text: Thomas Tuchel named his England squad for two Nations League matches this month. England play Croatia at Wembley on Thursday 12 November, then Spain in Madrid on Sunday 15 November. Jobe Bellingham has earned his first call-up and joins his brother Jude, while Josh King of Fulham is also in. Cole Palmer and Phil Foden are not included. Djed Spence and Ben White have returned to the squad.

gloss.call-up: an invitation to join a national team
gloss.squad: the group of players chosen for a team
gloss.Nations League: a competition between European national teams
gloss.earn: to get something because of good work
gloss.return to: to come back to a team or place

items.title: United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights
items.text: United Airlines has said that AI assistants may show its flight options, but customers must finish the purchase themselves. The airline gave several reasons, including personal data, accidental bookings and aviation rules. Passengers must still confirm that their checked bags contain nothing dangerous. Chief executive Scott Kirby said he does not want another middleman between the airline and its customers. United said it may look at the policy again as the technology improves.

gloss.AI agent: software that can act for a person without being told every step
gloss.middleman: a person or company between a seller and a buyer
gloss.look at again: to think about a decision once more

items.title: Forever chemicals linked to aggressive breast cancer
items.text: A study by the US National Institutes of Health has linked two common "forever chemicals" to a serious form of breast cancer. Women with high levels of the chemicals in their blood had up to 93% higher rates of an aggressive type of the disease. Forever chemicals are man-made substances that break down very slowly, so they stay in the environment and in the body. The study shows a link, not proof that the chemicals cause the cancer.

gloss.forever chemicals: man-made chemicals that take a very long time to break down
gloss.aggressive: growing or spreading quickly and strongly
gloss.man-made: produced by people, not by nature

items.title: Streamers add more content from online creators
items.text: US streaming services are showing far more programmes made by online creators. A study by Ampere Analysis found more than 3,700 hours of creator-led shows premiered in the third quarter of 2026, compared with 927 hours a year earlier. Tubi supplied over three-quarters of those hours, and reality made up 65% of the total. Among subscription services, Prime Video led with more than 230 hours. Netflix and Prime Video have also commissioned the most creator-led titles this year.

gloss.streamer: a company that offers films and shows online
gloss.creator: a person who makes videos for the internet
gloss.premiere: to be shown for the first time
gloss.commission: to order a new programme to be made

items.title: Trump backs Tim Cook to lead Nvidia
items.text: President Trump has said Tim Cook should replace Jensen Huang as chief executive of Nvidia. Mr Huang resigned after reports about his relationship with a businesswoman led the board to open an investigation. Mr Trump called Mr Cook, now Apple's executive chair, the only suitable choice, although he has no formal power over the appointment. Finance chief Colette Kress is acting chief executive. Nvidia faces shareholder legal action, and its shares fell by 5%.

gloss.appointment: the act of choosing someone for a job
gloss.acting: doing a job for a short time until a permanent person is found
gloss.shareholder: a person who owns part of a company
gloss.investigation: an official effort to find out the facts

items.title: GTA VI will target 30 frames per second on consoles
items.text: Rockstar Games has said Grand Theft Auto VI is targeting 30 frames per second on every console, including the PS5 Pro. The game is due on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on 19 November, and no PC version has been announced. Rockstar said PS5 Pro players will get extra features such as ray-traced shadows. Pre-orders opened in June, with the standard edition priced at $79.99, and players can already pre-load the game. It is the first main Grand Theft Auto game since GTA V in 2013.

gloss.frames per second: the number of images a screen shows each second
gloss.target: to aim to reach a goal
gloss.pre-order: to pay for a product before it is released
gloss.pre-load: to download a game before it is released
gloss.ray-traced: using a technique that makes light and shadows look realistic
